summary: Curaleaf Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a formal take-over bid for all common shares of Aurora Cannabis, following a prior proposal. The offer provides total implied consideration of US$4.00 per Aurora share, comprising 0.3463 Curaleaf subordinate voting shares plus US$0.75 cash, based on Curaleaf's closing price of US$9.39 on August 10, 2026. This implies a 45% premium to Aurora's 30-day VWAP of US$2.75. Curaleaf expressed willingness to engage constructively with Aurora's board. The filing includes the press release and take-over bid circular. Watch for Aurora board response and shareholder tender dynamics.
